cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So in the previous video, we understood that a data engineer essentially creates this data pipeline
cues.zh: 上一支影片知道，資料工程師基本上會建立資料管線，

cues.en: for us, for people like data scientists to have available data to work with.
cues.zh: 讓資料科學家這類角色，有資料可以使用。

cues.en: But I want to use a different example.
cues.zh: 不過想換一個例子。

cues.en: Let's pretend that Keiko Corp. has a need, and that need is for water.
cues.zh: 假設 Keiko Corp. 有一項需求，就是水。

cues.en: The employees need water.
cues.zh: 員工需要喝水。

cues.en: To work hard, right?
cues.zh: 才能努力工作，對吧？

cues.en: So let's think of this as a problem that a data engineer solves.
cues.zh: 把它當成資料工程師要解決的問題。

cues.en: Now, bear with me.
cues.zh: 先跟著想。

cues.en: We're going to be talking about water for a few minutes, but I promise it relates to data.
cues.zh: 接下來幾分鐘會談水，但保證和資料有關。

cues.en: You see, the very first thing for us to get water is rain rate.
cues.zh: 要取得水，最先需要下雨，對吧？

cues.en: We need rain.
cues.zh: 我們需要雨。

cues.en: And this is similar to the data sources that we had.
cues.zh: 就像前面那些資料來源。

cues.en: That is the websites, the mobile phones, the cameras, the cars, the drones.
cues.zh: 網站、手機、攝影機、汽車、無人機。

cues.en: All of these are collecting data.
cues.zh: 全都在收集資料。

cues.en: That's what the raindrops are.
cues.zh: 雨滴就代表這些資料。

cues.en: So in order for us to get water to our employees, we have to get water from somewhere.
cues.zh: 要把水送給員工，必須先有水源。

cues.en: And that water comes from rain.
cues.zh: 水來自降雨。

cues.en: Next that water gets collected into different streams and rivers from all over the place, from all
cues.zh: 接著各地、世界，

cues.en: over the world, just like data from all different places.
cues.zh: 各處的水匯成溪流和河川，就像資料來自各個地方。

cues.en: These streams of water start forming.
cues.zh: 水流開始形成。

cues.en: And what happens next?
cues.zh: 再來呢？

cues.en: Well, these streams of water turn into lakes.
cues.zh: 水流匯聚成湖泊。

cues.en: They all flow into some sort of a lake.
cues.zh: 流進某個湖裡。

cues.en: And that lake kind of sits still.
cues.zh: 湖水相對靜止。

cues.en: But again, we as a corp just want water from employees.
cues.zh: 但身為公司，我們只是希望員工有水喝。

cues.en: Well, we obviously have a dam on a lake and that dam on a lake or a system to use that lake.
cues.zh: 需要在湖上有水壩，或某種利用湖水的系統。

cues.en: Well, we transport that water to something like a filtration sanitary area so that we can clean the
cues.zh: 將水輸送到過濾、淨化區域，才能清潔，

cues.en: water, sanitize it, so it's safe for people to drink.
cues.zh: 消毒，讓大家可以安全飲用。

cues.en: So we process that water that has been collected.
cues.zh: 也就是處理收集到的水。

cues.en: And then finally, after all of that, we create all the plumbing and pipes for us to deliver water to Keiko Corp..
cues.zh: 最後架設水管與管線，把水送到 Keiko Corp.。

cues.en: That's how we satisfy the needs of KeyCorp to provide water for their employees.
cues.zh: 這樣就滿足公司提供員工飲水的需求。

cues.en: And this is how data works.
cues.zh: 資料也是這樣運作。

cues.en: And this is what a data engineer builds.
cues.zh: 這就是資料工程師建立的系統。

cues.en: A data engineer.
cues.zh: 資料工程師，

cues.en: Starts off with what we call data ingestion.
cues.zh: 先從稱為資料擷取，也就是 data ingestion 的步驟開始。

cues.en: That is acquiring data from various sources.
cues.zh: 從各種來源取得資料。

cues.en: And we acquire all these different sources of data and ingest it into what we call a data lake.
cues.zh: 取得各種來源的資料，再匯入所謂的資料湖。

cues.en: A data lake is a collection of all this data into one location.
cues.zh: 資料湖就是把所有這些資料集中在一個位置。

cues.en: From there, we could just leave the lake as it is.
cues.zh: 可以讓湖維持原樣。

cues.en: But there's a problem.
cues.zh: 但有個問題。

cues.en: We don't want the lake to overflow, dry up.
cues.zh: 不希望湖水溢出，也不希望乾涸。

cues.en: We need to manage this lake somehow.
cues.zh: 需要某種方式管理。

cues.en: We don't want to flood the village.
cues.zh: 不希望淹掉村莊。

cues.en: We need dams.
cues.zh: 需要水壩。

cues.en: We need pipes to the houses.
cues.zh: 需要通往住家的管線。

cues.en: We need to filter and clean the water and we need piping to the houses.
cues.zh: 需要過濾、清潔水，也需要輸送到住家的管線。

cues.en: So after we ingest this data from various sources, we collect it in a data lake.
cues.zh: 所以從各種來源擷取資料後，先集中到資料湖。

cues.en: We then perform something called data transformation that is converting data from one format to another, usually into something we call a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 接著做資料轉換，把資料由一種格式轉成另一種，通常放進所謂的資料倉儲。

cues.en: A data warehouse is a place that stores accessible data that is useful for the business.
cues.zh: 資料倉儲是一個地方，儲存容易存取、對企業有用的資料。

cues.en: That is, although the lake collected so much water, so much data, that was kind of all over the place.
cues.zh: 雖然湖收集很多水、很多資料，但內容比較雜亂。

cues.en: A data engineer looks at this data and forms or uses the parts of the data that are useful and puts
cues.zh: 資料工程師查看資料，整理或取出有用的部分，放進，

cues.en: it in a data warehouse so that other parts of the business can use it again.
cues.zh: 資料倉儲，讓公司其他部門使用。

cues.en: A good way to think about it is that a data lake is a pool of raw data.
cues.zh: 可以這樣理解：資料湖是一池原始資料，

cues.en: The purpose of which we still don't know what to do with in a data warehouse is a location for structured,
cues.zh: 還不確定每份資料要做什麼；資料倉儲則放結構化、

cues.en: filtered data that has been processed and has a specific purpose.
cues.zh: 篩選、處理過，而且有明確用途的資料。

cues.en: That is, we have data in here that is useful for the business.
cues.zh: 也就是裡面有對企業有用的資料。

cues.en: So that means that data lakes are usually less organized and has less filtration of data than something like a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 所以資料湖通常比資料倉儲更缺乏組織，資料也較少經過篩選。

cues.en: Now, why would businesses want to do that?
cues.zh: 企業為什麼要這樣做？

cues.en: Well, for one, it's a lot easier to analyze data when it's organized a well.
cues.zh: 首先，資料整理好，分析就容易得多。

cues.en: We also might have data in here that we don't really need.
cues.zh: 資料湖也可能有一些根本不需要的資料。

cues.en: We also save on storage space, right?
cues.zh: 還能節省儲存空間，對吧？

cues.en: Because we don't have to store all of this data and just store structured data only that is only useful to us.
cues.zh: 因為不必儲存全部內容，只保留對自己有用的結構化資料。

cues.en: We also save ourselves some money.
cues.zh: 也能省錢。

cues.en: So to review a data engineer simply builds this pipeline of taking the data creation and data capture,
cues.zh: 複習一下，資料工程師建立管線，從資料產生與收集開始，

cues.en: using data engineering practices to build this pipeline so that data can now be analyzed by data scientists
cues.zh: 運用資料工程實務，建立這套管線，讓資料科學家，

cues.en: and data analysts.
cues.zh: 與資料分析師得以分析資料。

cues.en: But we still have a little bit more to go.
cues.zh: 不過還有一點內容。

cues.en: So I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
